limits: Loopback, synthetic TURN ChannelData framing; not a TURN server, ICE, DTLS/SCTP or live Parsec session.
Timing runs contain no instrumented IO wrappers. Counts are from a separate local run.
Only TLS 1.3 was measured; no claim about TLS 1.2 timing.
Batch inputs are already available; no fill timer. Existing Conn API has no send-many contract.
Buffered Conn receive copies each frame to caller; unlike BUD borrowed input it is not zero-copy.
Receive burst first-frame/group timings are not network-arrival or end-to-end latency.
